newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Nuplex buys Australia chemical waste plant.
newsitem.headline: Nuplex buys Australia chemical waste plant.

text.p: Nuplex Industries Ltd said on Wednesday it had purchased a solvent recycling plant at Morwell, Victoria, Australia, from Nova Group Ltd for an undisclosed sum.
The plant, licensed to process chemical waste, has been operating since last September, Nuplex said in a statement.
"The acquisition is Nuplex's first investment in the waste treatment business in Australia," Nuplex said.
"The business, operating as part of Nuplex's Environmental Division, is expected to grow steadily during the next three years."

Nuplex said the Morwell plant had additional land and established infrastructure available to support expansion into the full range of Nuplex's hazardous waste treatment processes, including Cure technologies, its organochlorine treatment joint venture.
The new plant would trade as Nuplex Environmental and operate as part of Nuplex Industries (Aust.) Pty Ltd.
